name: Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center
name_zh: 北京人形机器人创新中心
summary:
Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center develops complete embodied-intelligence systems, combining humanoid hardware, control models, data services and testing infrastructure. Established in November 2023, its core platforms include the Tien Kung robot family and HuiSi KaiWu, a general-purpose embodied intelligence platform intended to support multiple tasks and robot types.

Its public applications include exhibition guidance, industrial-part sorting, equipment inspection and autonomous handling. The center also develops datasets and benchmarks, including RoboMIND, and provides facilities for prototyping, assembly, performance testing and process validation. It works with research organizations, developers and industry partners to move robotics technology from laboratory development into application trials.
